notes.title: Chef's Tail Patch #1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/f4743896be91172031ee297ef0fd80eef5be4925.png
Hello friends!
We've gathered all the feedback from you (thanks for it <3) and prepared the first Chef's Tail Update #1

What was changed (all on the graphic but there you go^^):
-fixed the critical bug that occurred when attempting to gift Eros and Anteros (now their reputation is maxed out from the beginning as it should be!)
-shop UI improvements - now the shopping interface has cleaner colors and bigger fonts - a lot more colorblind-friendly!
-fixed the bug with the 4th gift with every NPC -no more crashes!
-lot of random minor bug fixes

Join our discord channel and share with us what you think:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/c2a87dce3c36ab6c47d1c1353c73e56ebcbf60e3.jpg

have fun!
Chef's Tail team
